formation.locator: neutrino.kek.jp/k2k_faq.html (no formation date stated on the page)
formation.note: No explicit collaboration-formation date was found in the sources fetched. The FAQ page describes K2K as 'a Japan-Korea-US collaborative research project'; data taking began in June 1999 (see experiment:k2k intervals).

intervals.label: K2K Collaboration
intervals.note: Start taken from the beginning of K2K data taking (no separate collaboration-formation date is published). Status is 'completed' because K2K data taking ended in November 2004, but no source states a formal collaboration-dissolution date, so end is left null under the terminal-status uncertain-confidence exception (v0.2 A17; §4) rather than assigning an unsourced end date.

country_count.note: The FAQ page names Japan, Korea and the US as participants but gives no numeric country count.
country_count.quote: It is a Japan-Korea-US collaborative research project

institution_count.note: No numeric institution count is published in the K2K sources fetched (FAQ page, tutorial page, PRD 2006 measurement paper); the collaboration is described only qualitatively.

member_count.note: No member count is published in the sources fetched.

name: K2K Collaboration
notes: Membership counts are unrecorded (null) rather than estimated: no fetched source publishes institution, country or member totals for K2K (v0.2 A17).
Derived field collaboration.experiment_ids is deliberately not written (v0.2 A1).

summary.plain: The Japan-Korea-US team that built and ran K2K, the world's first long-baseline neutrino oscillation experiment, from 1999 to 2004.
summary.technical: Japan-Korea-US collaboration that operated the K2K experiment at KEK from June 1999 to November 2004. No official published institution/member/country counts were found.
